en.headline: Tuen Ma Line delays after signal fault near Kam Sheung Road
en.dek: Services between Hung Hom and Tuen Mun were disrupted for about an hour on Thursday afternoon after signalling equipment failed, with journey times extended by up to 30 minutes before normal operations resumed.
body: The MTR Corporation said signalling equipment near Kam Sheung Road station on the Tuen Ma Line failed at about 1.09pm on Thursday, forcing trains on the affected section to operate under single-track working.

Journey times between Hung Hom and Tuen Mun were initially extended by 15 to 20 minutes and later adjusted to 25 to 30 minutes. Services towards Tuen Mun and Wu Kai Sha continued, though at reduced frequency on the restricted section.

Engineers completed temporary repairs by 2pm, allowing both tracks to reopen with speed restrictions. Full signalling was restored at 2.23pm and train service gradually returned to normal. Extra staff were deployed at stations to assist passengers.
The Transport Department advised travellers to allow extra time and check station announcements for the latest information.

zh.headline: 屯馬綫錦上路站附近信號故障 紅磡至屯門一度延誤
zh.dek: 港鐵下午1時許因錦上路站附近信號設備故障實施雙向行車，紅磡至屯門行車時間最多額外30分鐘，約2時23分修復後服務逐步恢復。
body: 港鐵表示，今日下午約1時09分，屯馬綫錦上路站附近出現信號設備故障，相關路段實施雙向行車安排。
事故期間，往屯門及烏溪沙方向維持列車服務，但來往紅磡至屯門站的行車時間由最初額外15至20分鐘，其後調整至額外25至30分鐘。
工程人員下午2時完成臨時修復，雙線路軌重新開放但列車需慢駛；至2時23分信號設備修復，列車服務逐步回復正常。港鐵已在相關車站加派人手協助乘客。
運輸署呼籲乘客預留充裕時間，並留意車站最新服務資訊。
